description: Monitor Google Maps reviews and detect only NEW ones since previous runs (stateful tracking per business), with Bayesian urgency classification and optional Slack alerts — your reputation radar. Use when tracking review activity OVER TIME for businesses you already know. Use google_maps_scraper instead for one-shot bulk extraction of business data; use review_pitch_generator instead to turn existing bad reviews into a sales pitch and shareable report; use local_presence_audit instead for a one-time full presence audit. Returns review objects flagged isNew with urgency scores. Side effects: sends a Slack notification ONLY if you provide your own Slack webhook URL in the input — no messages are sent otherwise. Auth: Apify API token required (Authorization: Bearer). Rate limit: 60 calls/min/IP on this facade. Pricing: $0.25 per run + $0.01 per new review.
